scope: Public documentation for the YouTube per-connection timestamp origin: incident, fix, isolating comparisons and route updates. The matching source port is recorded separately.
adaptations: Present the incident as a consequence of the FIFO recovery-layer decision and link it from that contract.
Keep the three isolating tests in one case study so the local non-reproduction is read with the provider comparison.
Update the route, architecture and observation contracts to the copy process, byte-progress keeper check and copy-process facts.
Retain the 08:53 manual re-creation that reconnected the Twitch forward twice as a stated impact.

Process, Pod and connection identities, private evidence paths and API unit accounting.
Operator-side recording troubleshooting and guidance errors during the private player tests.
Claims of YouTube's internal disconnect reason, NVENC or production-capture equivalence, player recovery time or long-term stability.
